entries.zh-CN: 新增本地定时任务：按计划自动运行，可以查看历史和运行结论，保留产物，并在需要时通知你。
entries.en-US: Added local scheduled tasks: run on a schedule, review the history and outcome of each run, keep its artifacts, and get notified when needed.

entries.zh-CN: 工作流的交互节点会等对话真正结束后再让你确认完成，也可以手动强制完成。
entries.en-US: Interactive workflow nodes wait for the conversation to settle before you confirm completion, and can be completed by force.

entries.zh-CN: 可以在画布的连线上直接插入节点，拖动节点时显示对齐参考线。
entries.en-US: Insert a node directly on a canvas edge, and see alignment guides while dragging nodes.

entries.zh-CN: 对话中可以查看 OpenCode 子会话的过程，以及运行诊断信息。
entries.en-US: Chats can show the progress of OpenCode child sessions and run diagnostics.

entries.zh-CN: Skill 插件可以配置密钥，并在启动智能体时传给它。
entries.en-US: Skill plugins can be given secrets, which are passed to agents when they start.

entries.zh-CN: 选择基础分支时可以搜索，并显示完整的分支名。
entries.en-US: Base branches can be searched and show their full names.

entries.zh-CN: 插件设置页滚动时标题保持可见。
entries.en-US: The plugin settings header stays visible while scrolling.

entries.zh-CN: 修复插件更新或替换后，已有会话无法继续使用的问题。
entries.en-US: Fixed existing sessions no longer working after their plugin was updated or replaced.

entries.zh-CN: 修复重新打开对话后，子会话的内容归属不正确的问题。
entries.en-US: Fixed child session content being attributed incorrectly after reopening a chat.

entries.zh-CN: 修复编辑一个工作流节点时影响其他节点的问题。
entries.en-US: Fixed editing one workflow node affecting others.

entries.zh-CN: Skill 同步卡住时，可以在对话中恢复。
entries.en-US: A stuck Skill sync can be recovered from the chat.
